# Section Example

This deck's slide content can be split into separate `_SECTION_*.qmd` files
at the project root and pulled into `slides.qmd` with `{{< include >}}` --
see the top of `slides.qmd` for how this file is wired in, and the "Fast
iteration on a single section" note in README.md for how to preview a
section like this one on its own.

## Here's a sample slide

You can see that while there are a few quirks, the separate slides can display primarily as they will in the final deck.
